description: This file contains a script for synchronizing challenge files and their metadata across different language directories in a curriculum project. It performs directory traversal, file copying, and metadata updates based on matching IDs and dashed names.

methods.name: loadDirectory
methods.description: Recursively loads all files in a directory, filtering out system files like 'DS_Store'.

methods.name: syncChallenges
methods.description: Main function that synchronizes challenge files and their metadata across language directories, updating IDs and dashed names, and removing files without English counterparts.
